response.sql:
WITH project_spatial AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    s.boxy,
    s.boxx,
    s.aream2,
    s.volm3
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
),
source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    fundflux,
    AVG(1.0 * (boxy - boxx) / NULLIF(boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference,
    SUM(aream2) / NULLIF(SUM(volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio
  FROM project_spatial
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
with_average AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS cross_source_average
  FROM source_stats
)
SELECT
  fundflux,
  avg_y_vs_x_difference,
  area_to_volume_ratio,
  area_to_volume_ratio - cross_source_average AS above_cross_source_average
FROM with_average
WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > cross_source_average;

assumptions.assumption: The simple cross-source average includes each funding source with at least one matching spatial record and a non-NULL area-to-volume ratio; SQLite AVG ignores NULL ratios. Records with missing inputs are ignored by their respective aggregates, and zero denominators yield NULL.
